entwurf.thema: AI‑Driven Quant Factor Mining with Qlib RD‑Agent

teile.text: Can AI automate quantitative investment research from exploring ideas to implementing productions?
teile.name: Hook
teile.szene: A dark room with glowing financial data screens displaying charts and statistical models, shot from a medium angle with cool blue lighting.

teile.text: Microsoft built Qlib as an open source platform supporting supervised and reinforcement learning.
teile.name: Platform
teile.szene: A developer working at a desk with terminal code scrolling rapidly, illuminated by screen light in a quiet modern office.

teile.text: The repository now includes RD‑Agent for automated factor mining and model optimization.
teile.name: Tool
teile.szene: A stylized interface overlay showing a repository view with code commits and automated agent scripts running in a clean workspace.

teile.text: It covers the entire quantitative investment chain from alpha seeking to order execution.
teile.name: Pipeline
teile.szene: A multi-step data processing pipeline visualization displayed on a sleek monitor with glowing connection lines and metrics.

teile.text: Unreleased updates introduce restricted recorder loads requiring explicit trusted opt in flags.
teile.name: Limitation
teile.szene: A security settings panel on a screen with a highlighted warning lock icon and code configuration lines.

teile.text: Always verify your artifact writer and storage permissions before reloading saved models.
teile.name: Workflow
teile.szene: A focused developer inspecting permission settings on a laptop screen under warm desk lamp illumination.

teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.name: CTA
teile.szene: A clean end screen featuring animated engagement buttons and a presenter in a leather jacket against a bright studio backdrop.

entwurf.beschreibung: Discover how Microsoft Qlib and RD‑Agent automate quantitative investment research and factor mining pipelines.
